subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.r@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Samantha — thanks again for a productive kickoff earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Goals (what success looks like)
- Improve search relevance CTR on product pages by >= 20% (baseline: 12% current).
- Keep inference latency p95 < 200ms for single-query flows.
- Demonstrate a cost model that hits <$0.80 per 1k tokens for productionized inference at expected QPS.

Scope (POC deliverables)
- 4-week pilot covering: sample dataset ingestion (privacy-safe subset), prompt set & eval harness (we'll run automated evals against your labeled relevance judgments), three prompt variants + two quantized model configs.
- Integration: Redwood hosted POC environment (dedicated pool) + simple API endpoints your engineers will call for A/B testing.

Metrics we'll track
- MRR@10 (mean reciprocal rank) and CTR lift vs baseline
- Latency p50/p95 and 99th percentiles
- Unit cost ($/1k tokens) and estimated monthly cost at projected QPS

Owners
- Acme: Samantha Lee (PM, POC owner), Jared Kim (Eng lead, integration).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (Customer success / PM liaison), Rishi Malhotra (SE / infra), Aditya Rao (Solutions engineering).

Timeline (high level)
- Week 0 (this week): Access & infra setup — exchange S3 path and allowlist, create service account, share sample prompts.
- Week 1: Baseline runs (current model + Redwood default config).
- Week 2: Prompt tuning & two model configs tested.
- Week 3: Full eval runs, compare metrics, iterate.
- Week 4: Final report, handbook for rollout + next-steps discussion.

Access / setup steps (what we need from you)
1) Provide an S3 path or temporary data upload with a de-identified sample (10-20k rows) + mapping of label schema.
2) Confirm IP allowlist or VPC peering preference (we can support both).
3) Identify a test API key/short-lived service account for us to use — we'll provide role instructions, not secrets.
4) Share the prompt set or examples you want evaluated (CSV preferred).

Attachments: Redwood-POC-Checklist.pdf (checklist & timeline), acme_sample_prompts.csv (example prompt set).

Immediate next actions
- Samantha / Acme: Send S3 path and confirm if you want us to hash PII client-side or if you will send already-obfuscated data.
- Redwood: Rishi to provision a dedicated POC instance and send setup instructions; Aditya to prepare initial prompt/eval harness.

If that summary looks right I’ll mark the HubSpot deal with the POC start date for this week and schedule a 30-min sync on Friday for baseline review.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Redwood-POC-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB), acme_sample_prompts.csv (text/csv, 18KB)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of clarifying Qs before we upload data: 

1) PII & obfuscation: We prefer to avoid sending any raw PII. Can Redwood run the evals on hashed/anonymized fields (we can provide SHA-256 hashed IDs and tokenized text), or do you need the original text for quality checks? Our security team requires that we never transmit user identifiers in plaintext.

2) Prompt set size & eval thresholds: For the eval harness, what's the recommended minimum prompt set size to produce stable MRR estimates? We were planning 5k queries; is that sufficient? Also, what's the threshold Delta we'd consider a successful improvement for the pilot (you mentioned 20% CTR target — how will that be measured during POC)?

3) SOC 2 / data residency: We will need SOC 2 evidence and confirmation that POC data will remain in the us-east-1 region.

I attached a lightweight sample extract (de-identified). We'll prepare the full 10-20k sample if hashing is acceptable.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Product Manager, Search
Acme Corp
---
Attachments: acme_poc_sample_deidentified.csv (text/csv, 12KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.m@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.r@redwood.ai>, Jared Kim <jared.kim@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 02:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Samantha — quick technical clarifications from the SE side. Short answers first: yes, hashing/anonymization is fine; we do not need raw PII to run prompt tuning or the eval harness. We do recommend a small subset of raw text (redacted) for qualitative error analysis, but that can be done on your side and screenshots/annotated examples shared rather than full exports.

Details / setup notes:
- Data: 5k-10k labeled queries is typically sufficient for stable signal on MRR/CTR for initial experiments; 5k should be OK if samples are representative. Please include a distribution sample (organic vs. paid, device type) if available.
- Region & compliance: We will provision the POC in us-east-1 per your request and will attach SOC 2 evidence into the HubSpot deal (Marissa will share the relevant artifact).
- Access options: 
  1) S3 upload: Create a bucket/path (e.g., s3://acme-poc/samples/) and grant an IAM role we provide (we'll share role ARN).
  2) Temporary upload: If you prefer not to create roles, we can provide a pre-signed PUT URL for a one-time upload.
- Allowlist: Please provide the CIDR/IPs to allow (we'll provide ours for testing).
- API & test keys: We will not ask for long-lived secrets. For the POC we can create a scoped, short-lived API token tied to the dedicated POC pool.

Example minimal S3 manifest format we expect (CSV): 
  id,query_text,label,metadata.device,metadata.source
  1,"cheap running shoes","relevant",mobile,organic

Setup artifacts attached: redwood-setup-instructions.md (contains IAM policy example, sample curl for upload, and how to request the pre-signed URL). I'll follow up in your HubSpot thread with the exact role ARN and a checklist.

If you can share the S3 path and confirm hashing approach today, I can provision the POC instance this afternoon.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
